_metadata.description: Target profiles and apply: declare what a scenario ships, render it, and write it to the /public/* layout and the electron assets.

requirements.title: Branding declaration in service.json
requirements.description: The service.json schema gains an optional branding block (brand slug plus a targets enum) with a matching control-plane model; profiles.Resolve reads it and returns the declared profiles, dropping electron-v1 when platforms/electron is absent.

validation.notes: profiles tests, declared-icon-targets rule tests, apply scratch-tree/idempotency tests; old root writer and derive-icons deleted.

requirements.title: web-public-v1 and electron-v1 defined once
requirements.description: The profiles package defines both profiles as Go data matching the concept document, and is the single source render, apply and validation read.

validation.notes: profiles tests, declared-icon-targets rule tests, apply scratch-tree/idempotency tests; old root writer and derive-icons deleted.

requirements.title: declared-icon-targets validation rule
requirements.description: A validation rule checks each declared target's existence, format, exact dimensions, opacity for opaque variants, maskable safe-zone containment, marker block presence, relative manifest srcs, and known placeholder hashes, at WARNING severity.

validation.notes: profiles tests, declared-icon-targets rule tests, apply scratch-tree/idempotency tests; old root writer and derive-icons deleted.

requirements.title: Apply writes the /public/* layout and electron assets
requirements.description: Apply writes every declared target to its profile path, rewrites only the marked index.html block, merges a relative-src site.webmanifest, updates og/twitter meta, and writes the electron PNGs, icon.ico and icon.icns from a staging directory.

validation.notes: profiles tests, declared-icon-targets rule tests, apply scratch-tree/idempotency tests; old root writer and derive-icons deleted.

requirements.title: The old root-layout writer and derive-icons are deleted
requirements.description: The root-layout icon writer (ui/public, manifest.json, src:/<file>) and the derive-icons command/RPC are removed, and every caller is updated in the same change.

validation.notes: profiles tests, declared-icon-targets rule tests, apply scratch-tree/idempotency tests; old root writer and derive-icons deleted.
